entities.name: Junji
entities.description: A dragon spirit from Kamigawa, the reincarnated form of the ancient dragon Kokusho, who dwells in the canals beneath Towashi's Undercity.

entities.name: Kokusho
entities.description: An ancient divine dragon who survived the Kami War and died defending Takenuma from an oni assault; reborn as Junji.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The catastrophic war in which many divine dragon spirits perished.

entities.name: Takenuma
entities.description: A swampy region whose people Kokusho defended and Junji abandoned.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A city whose Undercity canals are Junji's domain.

entities.name: Reckoner
entities.description: Gangs whose turf battles Junji's presence keeps from escalating.

events.summary: Kokusho survives the Kami War but dies decades later defending Takenuma from a brutal oni assault, and is reborn as Junji.
events.quote: met his end several decades later while defending the inhabitants of Takenuma

events.summary: Junji severs ties with Takenuma and establishes his domain in the canals beneath Towashi's Undercity.
events.quote: Junji chose to sever ties with the swampy region of Takenuma

relations.quote: He is the reincarnated form of the ancient dragon Kokusho

relations.note: He deters Reckoner gangs from escalating their turf battles.
relations.quote: preventing Reckoner gangs from escalating their violent turf battles
